sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: deliverability_per_paper_energy_procurement
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?deliverability ?deliverabilityLabel
WHERE {
  # Paper and its energy procurement template instance
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C102010 .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Deliverability reported for the procurement case
  OPTIONAL {
    ?contribution orkgp:P159005 ?deliverability .
    OPTIONAL { ?deliverability rdfs:label ?deliverabilityLabel }
  }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

# id: metric_per_paper_math_language_processing
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?metric ?metricLabel
WHERE {
  # Paper and its comparison contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C91000 .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .

  OPTIONAL {

    OPTIONAL { ?metric rdfs:label ?metricLabel }
  }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

# id: url_per_paper_guide
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?contribution ?url
WHERE {
  # Paper and its Guide template instance via the template hop path
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P45119 ?hop1 .
  ?hop1 orkgp:P45079 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C23011 .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Reported url of the guide
  OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P1003 ?url }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: type_of_table_per_paper_tabular_data
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?dataset ?datasetLabel ?typeOfTable ?typeOfTableLabel
WHERE {
  # Paper and its Tabular data description contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C52011 .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Dataset described by the contribution
  ?contribution orkgp:P34063 ?dataset .
  OPTIONAL { ?dataset rdfs:label ?datasetLabel }
  # Type of table stated on the dataset description
  OPTIONAL {
    ?dataset orkgp:P97117 ?typeOfTable .
    OPTIONAL { ?typeOfTable rdfs:label ?typeOfTableLabel }
  }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: validation_tool_per_paper_ontology_learning
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?section ?validationTool ?validationToolLabel
WHERE {
  # Paper and its ontology section reached via the HasSection path
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  ?paperContribution orkgp:HasSection ?section .
  ?section a orkgc:OntologySection .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Validation tool reported by the paper
  OPTIONAL {
    ?section orkgp:P41615 ?validationTool .
    OPTIONAL { ?validationTool rdfs:label ?validationToolLabel }
  }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
